//==
// # Time-varying field interfaces
//
// Fields whose values evolve over a timeline. The time argument is an Instant
// on the animation or simulation timeline.

// A planar scalar field that changes over time: animated masks, ripples,
// and evolving density maps.
interface ITimeVaryingScalarField2D
{
    EvalAtTime(x: Self, point: Point2D, time: Instant): Number;
}
